name: imageserver-context-aware-bounded-image-99a5
instr:
imageserver cannot carry cancellation and a finite, concurrency-safe work allowance from HTTP entry through still and animated processing. Add context-aware processing without changing synchronous APIs or results.

A caller-created `WorkBudget` atomically reserves positive units, reports the exact remainder through `WorkBudget.Remaining`, and returns `ErrWorkBudgetExceeded` without spending insufficient allowance. `NewExecution` creates an `Execution` where cancellation takes precedence before work; `Execution.Check` distinguishes cancellation from exhaustion.

Every processor, including crop, gamma, GIFT resize, GIFT rotation, and NFNT resize, must charge actual selected or resulting bounds to the same execution and suppress results after cancellation. `ContextProcessor` and `ProcessorFuncContext` carry execution state. `NewListProcessor` and existing `Processor` calls stay compatible. `ListProcessor.ProcessContext` runs children in declaration order and stops unchanged at the first error, cancellation, or exhaustion.

Still and GIF handlers must carry one execution through decoding, processing, every frame, and encoding. Preserve validation, identity, normalization, animation metadata, and error behavior; never publish transformed bytes after interruption. `ContextServer`, `ServerFuncContext`, `GetContext`, `ContextHandler`, `HandlerFuncContext`, and `HandlerServer.GetContext` propagate context in source-then-handler order. Keep legacy `Server.Get`, `Handler`, and `Get` pat
